name: Tarpa (Hungary)
description: White field with a yellow border, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tarpa: a blue and red shield with a black eagle, within a green wreath, below a scroll inscribed TARPA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tarpa arms with wreath and scroll
